authority: #K2-370 sec.3.3 / C32: the obstacle model must use TRUE SHAPES, not axis-aligned bounding boxes

change.before: every obstacle = axis-aligned BBOX; grid margin = width/2 + clearance + pitch/2
change.after: TRACK obstacles carry their true segment (a/b) and half-width; distance = point-to-SEGMENT minus half-width. Pads/vias/keepouts remain boxes and are NAMED as the remaining approximation. The box margin formula is unchanged (backward compatible).
change.measured_obstacle_mix: 3400 of 4076 obstacles on F.Cu now carry a true segment
change.fail_closed_guard: every routed polyline is re-checked with the true-shape oracle (poly_violations) before it may land; a violation is refused as a NAMED blockage

pitch_sweep_on_the_20_jobs_that_were_blo.basis: the board's real free corridors are ~0.5mm; a 0.5mm maze pitch cannot represent them, 0.25mm can (2 cells per corridor). NOT a tuned magic number: 0.20 gives the same result and 0.15 is worse (the 2*pitch endpoint snap cap shrinks with the pitch).

exam_A_effect.unchanged: C6 diff 0, C7 diff 0 (the block fidelity criteria still hold), refill 18 zones

remaining_blockers.note: the 10 remaining jobs are still flagged as AABB false positives, but the flag compares against TRACK copper only; the two hard refusals are a real pad collision (the moved block's pad lands on a dR port - a genuine block/outside conflict that must be resolved by the frame or the delta, not by the router) and one genuinely tight endpoint (0.035mm).
remaining_blockers.next: pads/vias as true shapes (oriented pad polygons) + the endpoint snap policy
